metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 2001 · The Fast and the Furious
metas.description: An undercover Los Angeles police officer infiltrates an illegal street racing crew suspected of high-speed cargo hijackings.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 2003 · 2 Fast 2 Furious
metas.description: Former cop Brian O'Conner is called upon to bust a dangerous criminal and he recruits the help of a former childhood friend and street racer who has a chance to redeem himself.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.5 · 2009 · Fast & Furious
metas.description: Brian O'Conner, back working for the FBI in Los Angeles, teams up with Dominic Toretto to bring down a heroin importer by infiltrating his operation.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.3 · 2011 · Fast Five
metas.description: Dominic Toretto and his crew of street racers plan a massive heist to buy their freedom while in the sights of a powerful Brazilian drug lord and a dangerous federal agent.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.0 · 2013 · Fast & Furious 6
metas.description: Hobbs has Dominic and Brian reassemble their crew to take down a team of mercenaries, but Dominic unexpectedly gets sidetracked with facing his presumed deceased girlfriend, Letty.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.1 · 2006 · The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
metas.description: A teenager becomes a major competitor in the world of drift racing after moving in with his father in Tokyo to avoid a jail sentence in America.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 7.1 · 2015 · Furious 7
metas.description: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.6 · 2017 · The Fate of the Furious
metas.description: When a mysterious woman seduces Dominic Toretto into the world of terrorism and a betrayal of those closest to him, the crew face trials that will test them as never before.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.4 · 2019 · Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw
metas.description: Lawman Luke Hobbs and outcast Deckard Shaw form an unlikely alliance when a cyber-genetically enhanced villain threatens the future of humanity.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 5.2 · 2021 · F9: The Fast Saga
metas.description: Dom and the crew must take on an international terrorist who turns out to be Dom and Mia's estranged brother.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 5.7 · 2023 · Fast X
metas.description: Dom Toretto and his family are targeted by the vengeful son of drug kingpin Hernan Reyes.
